funFact: A single honey beehive can house around 50,000 bees and produce enough honey to fill nearly 20,000 jars a year—now that's a busy bunch!

faqs.question: How do I know it’s really from a chemical-free farm?
faqs.answer: Bees don’t survive in chemical farms. Our thriving hives prove the ecosystem is truly organic.

faqs.question: Can I put my name or logo on the jar?
faqs.answer: Yes! Each bottle comes with a personalized label — great for gifts, resale, or personal use.

faqs.question: What if my hive doesn’t yield enough honey?
faqs.answer: We’ll still fulfill your promised yield by pooling from nearby hives — all from the same clean zone.

faqs.question: Is it safe for kids and elders?
faqs.answer: Yes! It’s raw, nutrient-rich honey. (Note: Not recommended for babies under 1 year.)

faqs.question: Can I gift this?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We offer premium boxes and message cards — your honey, your story, beautifully packed
